titulo: Carta — Cavalo do Xadrez (ilustração da janela)
prompt: Richly painted anime-inspired storybook illustration for a dark fantasy tarot card, full-bleed vertical scene that fills the whole tall narrow image edge to edge, portrait composition with the main subject in the center and atmospheric detail rising to the top and settling at the bottom. Fine ink linework, painterly gouache shading, intricate details, whimsical but dark mood, deep indigo and violet palette with crimson accents and warm candle-gold highlights, drifting glowing motes and soft fog. World of DEVO: a survival game of borrowed time where every player wears a ticking timer on the wrist, with clocks, tarot and masks everywhere. Chess collection: the scene stands on a vast polished black-and-white marble chessboard floor stretching into violet fog, colossal carved chess pieces loom in the background, cold moonlight with crimson and gold glints. A massive boulder transforming into a wild rearing black horse in mid-metamorphosis, half cracked stone and half living muscle, its mane bursting into violet flame, a hand still touching the stone, the silhouette of a giant knight chess piece behind. Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no numerals, no signature, no watermark, no logo, no card frame, no border, no ornamental frame, no panels, not a collage, not photorealistic, no 3d render.
